examples.en: Can the heart's flame die in the flame of the funeral pile?
examples.zh: 心的火焰会在火葬堆的火焰中熄灭吗？

examples.en: When she agreed to marry him he felt he had achieved his heart's desire.
examples.zh: 当她答应嫁给他时，他感到终于得到了自己的心上人。

examples.en: I was delighted to be able to eat my favourite dishes to my heart's content.
examples.zh: 我很高兴能够尽情地享用我最喜欢的菜肴。
